internal/service/result_paging_integration_test.go (new, package service) must contain:

TestReadmeInventoryAndPromise — read README.md from the repo root (package dir is internal/service, so "../../README.md"), split it at the two anchor headings, and positively assert in BOTH sections: the four tool names (search_tools, describe_tool, call_tool, retrieve_result) appear; the qualified promise terms appear (handle, page, total_pages, bounded preview, and byte-exact/byte-for-byte reconstruction); neither forbidden phrase above appears.

C. Per-surface handle-retrieval round-trip across producers (call_tool, direct invocation, search_tools, describe_tool): the issued handle's pages concatenate to that surface's own independent golden literal, and re-retrieving any page is byte-identical. Reuse the existing package harnesses; do not reimplement surface wiring.
D. Single-execution invocation-count assertion: the upstream backend is called exactly once per produced result, asserted across a full multi-page retrieval and again across the expiry-mid-sequence case.
To drive the injected clock you may install a resultStore built with an injected now (as newDeliveryOracle does) on the ToolSurface under test; production code must not change.
